title: (RHBA-2020:5403) OpenShift Container Platform 4.5.23 low-latency extras update
portal_summary: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform low-latency extras release 4.5.23, which adds must-gather integration, is now available.
portal_synopsis: OpenShift Container Platform 4.5.23 low-latency extras update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.5|x86_64
portal_solution:
For OpenShift Container Platform 4.5 see the following documentation, which
will be updated shortly for this release, for important instructions on
how to upgrade your cluster and fully apply this asynchronous errata
update:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/4.5/release_notes/ocp-4-5-release-notes.html

Details on how to access this content are available at
https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/4.5/updating/updating-cluster-cli.html.
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform is Red Hat's cloud computing
Kubernetes application platform solution designed for on-premise or private
cloud deployments.

This advisory contains the extra low-latency container images for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.5.23. See the following advisory for the container images for this release:

https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2020:5359

All OpenShift Container Platform users are advised to upgrade to these
updated packages and images.
